categories.name: Financial Calculators
categories.metaDescription: Free financial calculators for mortgages, overpayments and deal comparisons. Every tool shows the formula it uses and a worked example, so you can check it.
categories.blurb: Mortgages, tax, pay and savings — worked out properly, with the numbers shown.

categories.name: Health & Fitness Calculators
categories.metaDescription: Free health and fitness calculators for body measurements, training numbers and everyday reference figures. Each one explains the method behind the result.
categories.blurb: Body measurements, training numbers and everyday health reference figures.

categories.name: Date & Time Calculators
categories.metaDescription: Free date and time calculators for ages, date differences, working days and countdowns. Each shows how the result is worked out, not just the answer itself.
categories.blurb: Ages, date differences, working days and countdowns.

categories.name: Unit Converters
categories.metaDescription: Free unit converters for lengths, weights, cooking measures, temperatures and clothing sizes. Each shows the conversion factor used and a worked example.
categories.blurb: Units, sizes, cooking measures and temperatures.

categories.name: Text Tools
categories.metaDescription: Free text tools for counting, cleaning and transforming text, plus word games like unscramblers and anagram solvers. Everything runs inside your browser.

categories.name: Developer Tools
categories.metaDescription: Free developer tools — encoders, formatters, generators and validators. Everything runs in your browser, so nothing you paste is sent anywhere or stored.

categories.name: PDF Tools
categories.metaDescription: Free PDF tools to merge, split, rotate and edit PDFs entirely in your browser. Your files are never uploaded, so private documents stay on your own device.
categories.blurb: Merge, split and edit PDFs entirely in your browser — no upload, no sign-up.

tools.title: Mortgage Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Work out monthly mortgage repayments from the price, deposit, rate and term. See the interest and capital split for any month, and what overpaying saves.

tools.title: Mortgage Comparison Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Compare two or three mortgage deals side by side, fees included, to see which is genuinely cheapest — not simply which has the lowest monthly payment.

tools.title: Mortgage Overpayment Calculator
tools.metaDescription: See what overpaying your mortgage is worth: the interest you avoid and the years you cut off the term, from a monthly amount or a one-off lump sum.

tools.title: Stamp Duty Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Calculate UK stamp duty land tax on a property purchase, including first-time buyer relief and the additional property surcharge, with the bands shown.

tools.title: Take-Home Pay Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Work out your take-home pay after income tax, National Insurance and pension contributions, with a full breakdown showing where every deduction goes.

tools.title: Compound Interest Calculator
tools.metaDescription: See how savings grow with compound interest and regular monthly contributions. Compare rates and terms to find what your pot could realistically be worth.

tools.title: BMI Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Work out your BMI in metric or imperial units, see the WHO category it falls in, and the healthy weight range for your height. Free and instant.

tools.title: Blood Sugar Converter
tools.metaDescription: Convert blood glucose between mmol/L and mg/dL, and HbA1c between mmol/mol and percent. The UK and US use different units for both measurements.

tools.title: Word Unscrambler
tools.metaDescription: Unscramble letters into every word they can make, grouped by length from two letters upwards. Free, instant, and built on an everyday English dictionary.

tools.title: Anagram Solver
tools.metaDescription: Find every anagram of your letters, plus the shorter words hidden inside them. Type the letters in any order and get results instantly, with no sign-up.

tools.title: Words Starting With
tools.h1: Words Starting, Ending or Containing Letters
tools.metaDescription: Find words that start with, end with or contain any letters, with an exact-length filter for crosswords and word games. Combine filters to narrow results.

tools.title: Scrabble Word Finder
tools.metaDescription: Find the highest-scoring words from your Scrabble tiles, with letter values worked out for you. Sort by score or by length.

tools.title: Words With Friends Word Finder
tools.metaDescription: Find the best Words With Friends plays from your letters, with each word's tile score worked out. Sort by score or length.

tools.title: Word Counter
tools.metaDescription: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type, with reading and speaking time estimates. Ideal for essays, speeches and word-limited forms.

tools.title: Case Converter
tools.metaDescription: Convert text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase and snake_case instantly, and copy any version with a single click.

tools.title: Text Diff Checker
tools.metaDescription: Compare two blocks of text and see exactly which lines were added, removed or left unchanged. Useful for checking edits in documents, emails and code.

tools.title: Duplicate Line Remover
tools.metaDescription: Remove duplicate lines from a list or block of text, keeping the first of each. Options to ignore case and trim whitespace suit messy exported data.

tools.title: Remove Extra Spaces
tools.metaDescription: Strip extra spaces, tabs and blank lines from text pasted out of a PDF or document. Clean it up in one click before pasting it somewhere that matters.

tools.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator
tools.metaDescription: Generate placeholder Lorem Ipsum text by paragraph, sentence or word count. Copy it straight into a design mockup or a layout you are still testing.

tools.title: Text Reverser
tools.metaDescription: Reverse text letter by letter, word by word or line by line. Handy for checking palindromes, making novelty text, or flipping a list that came out backwards.

tools.title: Hash Generator
tools.metaDescription: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes from any text, all at once. Runs in your browser, so nothing you type is ever uploaded.

tools.title: UUID Generator
tools.metaDescription: Generate one or many version 4 UUIDs instantly, with uppercase and brace options. Created by your browser's crypto engine, never sent anywhere.

tools.title: Base64 Encoder
tools.metaDescription: Encode text to Base64 or decode it back to plain text, with full Unicode support and a URL-safe option. Everything is processed locally in your browser.

tools.title: URL Encoder
tools.metaDescription: Percent-encode text for use in a URL, or decode an escaped string back to plain text. Choose between whole-URL and single-value escaping as you need.

tools.title: JSON Formatter
tools.metaDescription: Format messy JSON, validate it, and see exactly where an error is. Get both a pretty-printed and a minified version. Nothing leaves your browser.

tools.title: Timestamp Converter
tools.metaDescription: Convert Unix timestamps to readable dates and back again, in seconds or milliseconds, with a live clock showing the current epoch time as you work.

tools.title: Number Base Converter
tools.metaDescription: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal at once. Invalid digits for the chosen base are flagged rather than silently ignored.

tools.title: Merge PDF
tools.metaDescription: Combine several PDFs into one file in any order you choose. Runs entirely in your browser, so your documents are never uploaded to anybody's server.

tools.title: Split PDF
tools.metaDescription: Extract selected pages from a PDF into a new file, using single pages or ranges. Everything runs in your browser, so nothing is uploaded anywhere at all.

tools.title: Delete PDF Pages
tools.metaDescription: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF and download the trimmed file. Strip blank scans, adverts or terms pages in seconds, with nothing uploaded to a server.

tools.title: Rotate PDF
tools.metaDescription: Turn sideways or upside-down PDF pages the right way up, all at once or page by page. Rotation is lossless and happens entirely inside your browser.

tools.title: Reorder PDF Pages
tools.metaDescription: Rearrange the pages of a PDF into any order you like and download the result. Move a page to the front or swap whole sections, with nothing uploaded.

tools.title: Images to PDF
tools.metaDescription: Turn JPG and PNG images into a single PDF, one image per page, with page size and margin options. Quality is preserved and nothing leaves your device.

tools.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF
tools.h1: Add Page Numbers to a PDF
tools.metaDescription: Add page numbers to a PDF in any position and format, with the option to skip a cover page or start from any number. Runs entirely in your browser.

tools.title: Watermark PDF
tools.h1: Add a Watermark to a PDF
tools.metaDescription: Stamp DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL or your own text across every page of a PDF, with adjustable opacity and angle. Processed on your device and never uploaded.
